Majhi Guddu,Motu,Penguin,Makde,

Guddi mala mahiti ahe majha he fkt tula asa sorry bolna tula hurt kelela theek nhu honar hyane but khara sorry baal me tula khup hurt kartoy itkya divsa pasun. Mla tul as radlela bagun nhi avdt baal tu smile karat rha pillu I love you soo much.

I am sorry. Truly, deeply, unconditionally sorry and aaj baal me je bolo tula sodun de badl khara sorry baal me asa kdhi hi bolnar pillu. I am really sorry baal please maaf kr mla me vapis kdich nhi bolnar as tujhi shapat.

Mala sorry mhanaycha aahe Guddi — khara sorry, just "sorry bol aani move on" wala nahi. Tujhya dolyat je hurt mala distay, to pahun majya aat kahitari tutat. Tuzya haasnya shivay mala he itke divas khup empty vatat hote baal, he tula sangta pn yet navta mla.

I promise you — I promise us — that I will choose you every single day. Not because I have to, but because losing you is something I refuse to imagine. You are my home, my safe place, my forever person. I love you soo much guddi.

Mi Baal promise karto — tula Pillu, tu majya aayushyat saglyat important person aahes. Tula khush thevna, tuzhi kalji ghena, tula manvna — tujha majya var ragvna mla khup avdata gg baal. Please asa vichar nko krus please majya var chid baal, tu mla avdt tujh chidna khup. 💕
